title: Supply the correct form of the word given in each sentence.
description: Read the sentence and provide the correct form of the word in brackets.

questions.text: The young mountaineer's courage and perseverance were truly __________.
After years of financial dependence, the entrepreneur finally gained total __________.
Even in the face of fierce criticism, she remained completely __________ to her principles.
The young chess player advanced __________ through every stage of the national tournament.
Rebuilding the destroyed medieval library was an extraordinarily __________ project for the city.
